versions.changelog:
Initial release — Automate B2C mobile app marketing with a proven short-form video content strategy.

- Covers content creation, scheduling, and performance tracking for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
- Includes account warmup, viral format research, content hooks, hashtag guidance, and AI-powered slideshow generation.
- Integrates with Post Bridge API for streamlined, multi-platform video posting and scheduling.
- Provides detailed workflow, best practices, and playbook for iterative growth and engagement-focused content.
